name: Financial Help On Death Of Family Head
benefit: Financial Assistance of ₹10,000 to the wife of the deceased head of the family is provided.
eligibility_rules: The person must be from Sahariya Tribe (ST)
documents_required: Bank Passbook PhotocopyAddress Proof : Ration cardCaste Certificate
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline The application form of the scheme can be obtained from and submitted to the Additional Collector and Project Officer, Shahbad.
